description.value: The Co-op Food store is part of Dawson Co-op, a locally-owned co-operative serving communities in the Peace Country region of northeastern BC including Dawson Creek, Chetwynd, Tumbler Ridge, and Rolla. It operates as a full-service grocery store with a staffed meat counter (including in-house sausage and jerky), fresh produce, deli, and an in-store bakery. As a member-owned co-op, it provides comprehensive grocery services in a remote northern BC hub along the Alaska Highway corridor.
